verdict.rationale: Rive offers agent-driven generation: an in-editor AI agent, MCP tools that let AI handle repetitive tasks such as building state machines and view models, and a CLI that lets an agent generate content. RML also enables text-based and coding-agent workflows, so external agents could script Rive work. Nothing shows automations that run on their own in the background; these are interactive or externally driven agent sessions. Missing for 10: scheduled or triggered background automations, headless or unattended job execution, monitoring or status of running automations, and independent corroboration.
